BurstDef.description: Particles a projectile of the look bursts into where it hits, spread over its splash.

colors.description: The colours its particles take instead of the look's, "#RRGGBB": fire's smoke is black, its embers orange. Without them, the look's colours.
colors.title: Colors

count.description: How many at once; a burst's emitters together at most 24.
count.title: Count

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:mote (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

spread.description: How far from the middle of the hit they appear and how fast they fly out, as a share of the burst's own: 1 fills it, 0 leaves them still at its middle (a ring that widens where a missile hit).
spread.title: Spread

BurstDef.title: BurstDef

SwirlDef.description:
Particles that swirl in toward a projectile of the look while it forms in a caster's hands, spawned by the
clients; a ``hands`` forming shows them alone.

colors.description: The colours its particles take instead of the look's, "#RRGGBB": fire's smoke is black, its embers orange. Without them, the look's colours.
colors.title: Colors

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:mote (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

per_tick.description: How many a tick while the cast runs; a swirl's emitters together at most 8, and each one's rate times its particle's longest life, summed, at most 80.
per_tick.title: Per Tick

SwirlDef.title: SwirlDef

TrailDef.description: Particles a projectile of the look leaves behind as it flies, spawned by its clients.

colors.description: The colours its particles take instead of the look's, "#RRGGBB": fire's smoke is black, its embers orange. Without them, the look's colours.
colors.title: Colors

particle.description: One of our particles, e.g. realmforge:mote (content/particles/).
particle.title: Particle

per_block.description: How many a block flown; a trail's emitters together at most 3.
per_block.title: Per Block

TrailDef.title: TrailDef

description: An element's look, shared by every spell of it: frost reads as frost on Frostbolt and on Ice Lance.

burst.description: What its projectiles burst into where they hit: at most 3 emitters.
burst.title: Burst

colors.description: Its colours, lightest first, "#RRGGBB": each particle takes one at random, and its placeholder material is noise in them. At most 16.
colors.title: Colors

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

impact_sound.description: The sound event of its projectiles' hit on a block or a creature, e.g. minecraft:block.glass.break. A spell may name its own (visuals.impact_sound).
impact_sound.title: Impact Sound

light.description: How its models are lit. world: by the light where they are, like an arrow. glow: a few light levels above that, lighting nothing (frost). emit: at full brightness (fire); it lights its surroundings once the pack has dynamic lights (ADR 0075).
light.title: Light

swirl.description: What swirls in toward its projectile while it forms in a caster's hands (the storm of a grow or storm forming, and all a hands forming shows): at most 3 emitters. The first one's particle also sparks at the growing edge of a model that forms cube by cube.
swirl.title: Swirl

trail.description: What its projectiles leave behind in flight: at most 3 emitters.
trail.title: Trail

title: SpellLookDef
